explanations: book() returns the promise from calendar.reserve() without awaiting it inside the try block. The async function settles with that promise after the try/catch has already exited, so when reserve rejects (409 because someone else just took the slot, or 429/5xx during an outage) the catch never runs. The raw HttpError escapes untranslated. The HTTP layer and the waitlist only understand scheduling errors, so the patient gets a 500 and isn't waitlisted. Errors from findSlot were translated correctly only because that call is awaited. `return await` keeps the rejection inside the try, so every calendar failure goes through toSchedulingError.
